text:
Iris Chen: Quick copy pass request for the empty-state tooltip on Sessions -> Restore. Current tooltip: "Restore a session to continue where you left off." Feels vague and hard to scan.
Devon: Agreed. Users don't always know what 'restore' does. We should show the effect and the time window.
Rosa: Two constraints: keep it to 1–2 lines in the tooltip and make CTA label consistent with other panels (verb-first).
Iris Chen: Draft variants:
- "Restore session — reopen your workspace at the point you left (within 24h)"
- "Resume session — reopen your workspace from where you left off"
Devon: Prefer "Resume session" as the main verb. Shorter. Add the 24h window only if we can guarantee it.
Nate (eng): We do expire session state after 24 hours in current design. If we include the window, put it in parenthesis. Also note mobile width is tight so keep CTA to 2 words max.
Copybot: Microcopy rules: primary action <=2 words, avoid parentheses in short tooltips, prefer sentence fragments for tooltips (no trailing period).
Rosa: Final proposal for mock:
"Resume session — reopen your workspace from where you left off (expires after 24 hours)"
Action label: "Resume session"
Iris Chen: I'll put this into the Figma. Nate, please confirm the 24h expiry text is accurate or we hide it.
Nate (eng): Confirmed 24h, but backend team may change policy. If that's unstable, drop the expiry and use: "Resume session — reopen your workspace from where you left off".
Devon: Also accessibility: tooltip should be reachable via keyboard and the action should be readable by screen readers as "Resume session, button, reopens workspace".
Iris Chen: Great — I'll add both variants (with/without expiry) to the component and mark the expiry line optional for translation. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
